answer: Each identity grows one crystal on a rented lab bench for 21 days from a solution whose impurity mix is seeded by its key, posted to a registry anchor before growth. A lab diffraction scan fingerprints lattice defects no other crystal reproduces; monthly, verifiers forge a fresh seed and regrowth must match it. One bench yields one crystal per cycle, so 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 benches at $190 monthly ($190,000 monthly), $60 per scan, and 21 uncompressible days per batch; cloned crystals fail and lose the slot. Trade-off: lab scarcity caps admission near 25 daily.
